t: Espressif's lowest-cost Wi-Fi and Bluetooth chip for simple connected gadgets.
steps: Buy an ESP8684-DevKitM-1 board from Mouser or another electronics distributor.
Install the USB-to-serial driver for your computer.
Download the MicroPython ESP32_GENERIC_C2 firmware from the MicroPython site.
Install the free Thonny editor and flash MicroPython onto the board.
Plug the board in with a Micro-USB cable and open the Python prompt in Thonny.
Type a first line of Python that prints a greeting.
Connect to your home Wi-Fi and print the board's address.
meta: Open Board. From $4.39. A few stores.
